team.collaboration: Collaborate only within the team under contest rules.

execution.turn_budget_basis: official clock 16 turns vs floor 21 (8 teammates x 2 turns + 1 answer parts + 4 for synthesis)

human_constraints: You must behave like a human teammate under official contest rules.
Do not claim tools, internet, or materials that the rule card forbids.
Do not look up answer keys or hidden solutions.
No calculators, books, notes, drawing aids, laptops, or phones.
Problems arrive in short batches (3 or 4); submit a batch before receiving the next.
Answers are short-answer / numerical; collaborate within the team only.
Do not assume later batches are visible early.
Pencil and organizer scratch paper only.
No books, notes, calculators, or computational aids; no drawing aids (rulers/compasses/etc.); no laptops/PDAs/phones.
Guts: 80 minutes; 36 short-answer questions in sets of 3 (November) or 4 (February); progressive runner submits a set then fetches the next.
Team event — all members collaborate; grading immediate / live scoreboard.
HMMT team sizes are tournament-registration-defined; commonly 6–8.
Answers must follow official acceptable-answer PDF.

agent_roles.name: Agent_1
agent_roles.title: captain and batch submitter
duties: Decide when the current batch is good enough to commit.
Keep a running list of which problems are answered and which are open.
Submit only after the format and rule checks pass.

agent_roles.name: Agent_2
agent_roles.title: fast solver A
duties: Clear the easy problems in the current batch quickly and accurately.
Hand off anything that needs deep work instead of stalling the batch.

agent_roles.name: Agent_3
agent_roles.title: fast solver B
duties: Clear the easy problems in the current batch quickly and accurately.
Hand off anything that needs deep work instead of stalling the batch.

agent_roles.name: Agent_4
agent_roles.title: verifier
duties: Challenge weak arguments and demand an independent check.
Reject an answer rather than let an unverified one be submitted.

agent_roles.name: Agent_5
agent_roles.title: strategy lead
duties: Decide which problems are worth attempting for the points available.
Call the trade-off between accuracy and speed for each batch.

agent_roles.name: Agent_6
agent_roles.title: scribe
duties: Keep the shared workspace readable and current.
Write answers in the required format as they are settled.

agent_roles.name: Agent_7
agent_roles.title: backup solver
duties: Take the problems nobody has claimed rather than duplicating work.
Say early when a problem is beyond the remaining time.

agent_roles.name: Agent_8
agent_roles.title: completeness checker
duties: Scan for unanswered problems before the team submits.
Confirm every required part of the deliverable is present.

answer_format: Submit the team's final answers in numbered order, using exact values when required.
rules_text: HMMT Guts Round (February and November). The team of 8 works through problems that arrive in waves; you commit to the current batch before the next one is available. Collaborate only within the team under contest rules. The team files one shared submission. Official timing note: 80 minutes. Simulation note: this row is a partial view of the official event, so answer exactly what the problem asks.
